hero.titleTail: Catheter Packaging Trays, Cleanroom Class 8 · Vapi
hero.desc: Custom PETG thermoformed catheter packaging trays, stent packaging, guide wire packaging, angioplasty balloon packaging — face seal blister components for vascular device sterile packaging. Manufactured in Cleanroom Class 8 under GMP and ISO 9001:2015. Vascular packaging manufacturer from Vapi, Gujarat.

strips.title: Guide Wire Kink Stress — Packaging Coil Geometry Must Respect Minimum Bend Radius
strips.desc: Problem: Guide wire packaging where the coil radius is below the guide wire's minimum bend radius causes permanent kink deformation — the guide wire is non-functional. Guide wire kink damage from packaging is not visible in the sealed blister. Solution: Minimum bend radius confirmed from guide wire technical specification. Coil cavity radius designed to exceed the minimum bend radius.

strips.title: Long Catheter Linear Geometry — Packaging Must Maintain Lumen Patency
strips.desc: Problem: Catheter packaging where the tray imposes a sharp bend in the catheter body can cause partial lumen collapse — the catheter lumen has reduced internal diameter at the bend. Solution: Catheter curve geometry confirmed from the catheter's minimum curve radius specification. Tray cavity provides smooth curves with no sharp bend points.

strips.title: Trocar Tip — Sharp Point Must Not Contact Any Packaging Surface
strips.desc: Problem: Trocar tips are surgical cutting edges — any contact with the packaging material before use causes visible damage to the cutting edge. Solution: Trocar tip cavity with defined tip clearance zone — the trocar tip is suspended in clearance, no packaging contact on the tip geometry.

strips.title: Guide Wire Coil Cavity — Minimum Bend Radius Confirmed Before Tooling
strips.desc: Minimum bend radius confirmed from guide wire technical specification before coil cavity design. Cavity coil radius designed to exceed minimum bend radius. No kink stress on any section of the guide wire in the packaging.

strips.title: Catheter Lumen Patency — No Sharp Bend Points in Cavity Profile
strips.desc: Catheter curve radius confirmed from minimum curve specification. Tray cavity provides smooth curves with no sharp bend points that could partially collapse the catheter lumen.

strips.title: Trocar Tip Clearance — Cutting Edge No-Contact Geometry
strips.desc: Trocar tip clearance zone in cavity design — tip suspended with no packaging contact on the cutting edge geometry.

strips.title: Face Seal Flange for All Vascular Sterile Components
strips.desc: Heat seal flange geometry on all vascular device face seal blister components — flange width, corner radius, and surface flatness confirmed from device manufacturer's sealing equipment specification.
